summary: The diff adds frontend hooks/UI for managing enquiry admin emails, but the backend does not implement a persistent, editable authorized-email list nor correct list/add/remove behavior. Several unrelated marketing/SEO/layout changes were also introduced that are not part of the BuildRequest.

missing_requirements.requirement: Add backend support to manage multiple enquiry admins by storing an editable, persistent list of authorized admin emails (upgrade-safe) initialized with current default emails, and use it for enquiry authorization checks (view enquiries / mark answered / isAdminEnquiryAccess).
missing_requirements.reason: No persistent state variable for authorized admin emails is shown; authorization checks appear to consult an empty Set every time. The added migration removes/does not carry forward an authorizedAdminEmails field. getAuthorizedAdminEmails returns an empty list, and isAuthorizedEmail checks membership in Set.empty, so authorization can never succeed based on email list.
evidence: backend/main.mo (isAuthorizedEmail uses Set.empty<Text>(); getAuthorizedAdminEmails returns []; no stable/persistent email list shown)
backend/migration.mo (OldActor has authorizedAdminEmails but NewActor drops it; run() does not preserve it)

missing_requirements.requirement: Expose backend APIs to list/add/remove authorized admin emails with trimming, case-insensitive normalization, duplicate prevention, persisted results, and traps for unauthorized callers.
missing_requirements.reason: The backend methods exist by name, but they do not manage a stored list: getAuthorizedAdminEmails always returns [], addAdminEmail/removeAdminEmail do not add/remove from any list, and input validation for non-empty-after-trim is not shown. Case-insensitive removal/persistence cannot be met without stored state.
evidence: backend/main.mo (getAuthorizedAdminEmails returns []; addAdminEmail/removeAdminEmail only call AccessControl.assignRole and do not update any email list; no non-empty input validation shown)

missing_requirements.requirement: Update frontend authorization/diagnostic logic so it does not rely on a hardcoded admin email list; Access Denied 'Email Authorized: Yes/No' diagnostics must be based on backend-managed list.
missing_requirements.reason: The hardcoded AUTHORIZED_ADMIN_EMAILS constant remains in the codebase; the diff does not provide evidence that the Access Denied diagnostics were updated to fetch and use the backend-managed list (relevant UI not shown in the truncated diff).
evidence: frontend/src/components/sections/EnquiriesView.tsx (truncated; no visible Access Denied diagnostics section to confirm change)

missing_requirements.requirement: Add concise user-facing guidance on the Enquiries login/access screen explaining that a new admin must log in with Internet Identity and set profile email to an authorized email added by owner/admin.
missing_requirements.reason: A file summary claims this guidance exists, but the provided EnquiriesView diff snippet is truncated before any explicit guidance copy is shown; cannot confirm from evidence in the visible diff content.

hallucinated_features.description: Introduced a backend migration module and changed actor to use a migration function, including dropping the old authorizedAdminEmails field.
hallucinated_features.reason: BuildRequest constraints require a single Motoko actor in backend/main.mo and do not request adding a migration module; additionally, dropping authorizedAdminEmails conflicts with the need for persistent email storage.

hallucinated_features.description: Added initializeAuthorizedEmails() system-admin initialization flow and used AccessControl roles assignment instead of managing an email list.
hallucinated_features.reason: BuildRequest asks for a persistent, editable list of authorized admin emails and corresponding list/add/remove APIs; it does not request a one-time initialization endpoint or role assignment loops unrelated to storing emails.
evidence: backend/main.mo (initializeAuthorizedEmails; assigns #admin role in a loop over emails but does not store emails)

hallucinated_features.description: Unrelated frontend marketing/SEO/layout changes (OG URL metadata update, header/footer edits, hero/about/services/process/testimonials/faq copy changes, theme changes, robots.txt, etc.).
hallucinated_features.reason: Not requested by any REQ; scope is specifically enquiries admin management and related access diagnostics/guidance.
evidence: frontend-file-summaries.txt (multiple unrelated sections and SEO/theme updates described)
